summary.text: Keri Weems is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 11 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, she faces Democrat Sonja Mentzer and Libertarian Tracey Quint, along with fellow Republican incumbent Brian Mulder, for the district's two seats.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Keri Weems's 2025-2026 committee assignments as the House Military and Veterans' Affairs, Taxation and Transportation committees.
